name: A creature keeps its scale auras when a transform ends
contract: Unit::RestoreDisplayId puts a creature back on its native model at its native scale. A scale aura on it, such as
Tiny 80087 (-90 %), must stay in effect when a transform such as Polymorph 118 ends; before, the restore set the
scale to the native value alone and dropped the aura's part.

steps.label: CONTROL: the creature stands at scale 1
DISCRIMINATING: after the Polymorph ends it is still at 0.1
